End-to-End Traceability: Lead the team in tracing transaction flows from the API Gateway (API Connect) through the Enterprise Service Bus (ACE) to the backend Microservices (Spring Boot).

IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I)
App Connect Enterprise (ACE): Troubleshoot message flows, ESQL logic errors, and adapter connectivity issues (SAP, Database, File).
IBM MQ: Manage queue managers, resolve channel retries, and investigate dead-letter queues or message persistence issues.
API Connect: Resolve issues related to API definitions, security policies, and Gateway (DataPower) latency.
Backend Microservices (Spring Boot)
Performance Tuning: Analyze JVM thread dumps and heap dumps to resolve memory leaks or high CPU utilization in microservices.
Connectivity Debugging: Troubleshoot Spring Boot integration with databases (JPA/Hibernate) and external messaging systems (JMS/Kafka).
Log Aggregation: Utilize ELK/Splunk to correlate logs across multiple microservices to identify points of failure in a distributed architecture.

Technical Skill Set

Integration Platforms: Mastery of IBM CP4I (specifically ACE, MQ, and API Connect).
Development Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Java and Spring Boot (Spring Integration, Spring Cloud).
Containerization: Expert-level proficiency in Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
Protocols & Standards: Expert understanding of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, AMQP, and MQTT.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Cloud & SaaS Integrations
jobs.description:
Location

Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
Working proficiency in SQL
Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

Experience building integration platforms or extensibility frameworks as a core part of a product
Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do'er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

Unlimited Vacation
Flexible Working Options
Health Insurance
Parental Leave
Employee Stock Option Plan
Home Office Allowance
Professional Development Stipend
Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team , where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

new_jobs.title: Data, Analytics & AI Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
We Are Teva

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

Our Team, Your Impact

DADAI (Data, Analytics, Digital & AI Delivery) is building a next generation enterprise delivery engine that turns the company’s biggest opportunities into measurable outcomes using data products, digital automation and applied AI. The ambition is to combine startup pace with enterprise discipline: product thinking, predictable delivery at scale, strong engineering standards, and clear architecture, security and quality gates that enable speed without compromising control.

DADAI has been shaped as an enterprise “factory”, 200+ engineers, designed to absorb significant demand across multiple global domains, industrializing the path from idea to production and continuous improvement while scaling through strategic partners and still preserving internal knowledge and ownership. This is a rare opportunity to join a new leadership organization and to help set how the Teva will use data, analytics and AI to modernize decision making, automate critical processes, and accelerate innovation across core functions and value chains.

The Role

We are seeking a highly hands-on senior architect to lead solution design across enterprise data, analytics, and AI initiatives in a Microsoft-first environment. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into secure, scalable, supportable architectures and guiding delivery teams through design, prototyping, implementation, reviews, and production readiness. The ideal candidate combines strong architecture leadership with proven hands-on depth in Power BI, Azure data platforms, and enterprise AI enablement.

How You’ll Spend Your Day

Own end-to-end solution architecture for data, analytics, and AI use cases, with accountability for design quality, security, scalability, supportability, and cost.
Translate business needs into practical technical designs, target architectures, integration patterns, and delivery-ready implementation guidance.
Lead by example through hands-on prototyping, architecture reviews, troubleshooting, code/design reviews, and technical support for delivery teams.
Ensure security, governance, compliance, and operational readiness are built into solutions from design through production deployment.

Your Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
15+ years of IT experience, including 10+ years in senior solution architecture roles for enterprise data, analytics, and AI platforms.
2+ Years experience in hands-on delivery of with Microsoft-first AI platforms and services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Search, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow, and enterprise AI governance patterns.
7+ years strong hands-on experience with Azure-based data platforms, including Azure Data Factory, Databricks, data lake architectures, SQL, and dimensional data modeling, with the ability to build practical end-to-end solution designs.
Proven ability to own solution architecture end to end: shape target designs, validate them through prototyping or proof of concept where needed, guide delivery teams through implementation, and provide technical oversight through design reviews, code reviews, and production readiness checks.
Strong experience with enterprise security, governance, and compliance, and the ability to work effectively with enterprise architects and guiding or regulatory functions to ensure solutions meet organizational standards and control requirements.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to drive alignment across architects, delivery teams, business stakeholders, and enterprise control functions.

Key Skills

Hands-on technical leadership with a clear lead-by-example mindset.
Strong architecture judgment across data, analytics, AI, integration, security, and non-functional requirements.
Ability to translate business problems into practical, delivery-ready technical solutions.
Strong troubleshooting, decision-making, estimation, and risk management capability.
Comfort working across distributed teams and external suppliers in enterprise delivery environments.

Also Good to Have

Deep hands-on expertise in Power BI architecture, including semantic models, DAX, Power Query, workspace strategy, governance, performance optimization, and enterprise reporting patterns.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform governance, Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, and CI/CD for analytics or AI solutions.
Experience with Microsoft security and governance services such as Microsoft Entra, Purview, and Key Vault.
Experience in life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or other regulated industries.
Relevant Microsoft certifications in Azure, Power BI, data, or AI architecture.

Core Technology Stack

Data platform
: Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Azure data lake, SQL, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT, orchestration.

AI platform
: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow.

Analytics
: Power BI, semantic models, DAX, Power Query, Databricks, enterprise reporting and governance.

Engineering and governance
: Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, CI/CD, Microsoft Entra, Purview, Key Vault.

Optional / advantageous
: Microsoft Fabric, Python, data observability and monitoring patterns.

How We’ll Take Care Of You

At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community.  When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way. 

Already Working @Teva?

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development

W uTopiVR szukamy dwóch programistów Unity/C# do współpracy przy edukacyjnym symulatorze obsługi elektrolizera. Projekt obejmuje interaktywne środowisko VR oraz wersję dostępną przez przeglądarkę.
Obecnie kompletujemy zespół i przygotowujemy ofertę cenową. Rozpoczęcie realizacji zależy od pozyskania zamówienia. Zapraszamy do zgłaszania się indywidualnie — nie trzeba tworzyć dwuosobowego zespołu.
Zakres prac, do podziału w zespole:

Programowanie interakcji VR: chwytanie i używanie narzędzi, obsługa elementów urządzenia, wykonywanie procedur.
Implementacja logiki scenariuszy edukacyjnych, ćwiczeń, oceny wykonania zadań i grywalizacji.
Integracja modeli 3D, animacji, interfejsów oraz materiałów dydaktycznych.
Przygotowanie funkcjonalności wersji przeglądarkowej.
Testowanie na sprzęcie VR, optymalizacja wydajności, przegląd kodu i usuwanie błędów.
Przygotowanie dokumentacji technicznej oraz instrukcji uruchamiania i budowania projektu.

Czas i forma współpracy:

Główna realizacja ma potrwać do 6 miesięcy od podpisania umowy na projekt. Pierwsze 2 miesiące obejmują przygotowanie i uzgodnienie projektu funkcjonalnego; w terminie 6 miesięcy całość musi być gotowa do odbioru.
Następnie przewidziane są testy z użytkownikami, poprawki i prace rozwojowe do 20 listopada 2027 r. Liczbę godzin, podział zadań i sposób rozliczenia ustalimy indywidualnie.
Osobno chcemy uzgodnić warunki późniejszego wsparcia przy usuwaniu błędów — projekt wymaga co najmniej 24 miesięcy gwarancji od odbioru gotowego rozwiązania.
Wymagania:

Minimum 2 lata doświadczenia w programowaniu aplikacji VR w Unity — wymagane od każdej osoby.
Dobra znajomość C# i praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu interakcji VR.
Umiejętność diagnozowania błędów i optymalizacji aplikacji.
Praca z Gitem i umiejętność współpracy nad wspólnym projektem.
Gotowość do przekazania kodu źródłowego i dokumentacji swojej pracy.
Możliwość potwierdzenia doświadczenia: okresy pracy nad projektami, wykorzystane technologie i własny zakres odpowiedzialności.

Mile widziane:

Doświadczenie z Meta Quest, OpenXR i XR Interaction Toolkit.
Znajomość Unity 6.
Projekty edukacyjne, szkoleniowe lub symulatory techniczne.
Doświadczenie z WebGL i dostosowywaniem aplikacji do różnych sposobów sterowania.

W zgłoszeniu prosimy o:

Krótki opis doświadczenia w Unity i VR, z datami lub okresami realizacji projektów.
Portfolio, filmy demonstracyjne lub opis wdrożeń wraz ze wskazaniem własnego wkładu.
Proponowaną stawkę godzinową, informację netto/brutto i formę rozliczenia.
Dostępność godzinową w miesiącu oraz możliwy termin rozpoczęcia.
Informację, czy dysponujesz goglami do testów i jakim modelem.
Informację o możliwości dalszej współpracy przy utrzymaniu aplikacji.

new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Summary

Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.

This is not a order-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.

Key Responsibilities

Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI-enabled solutions.
Build and deploy agentic AI systems end-to-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.
In Studios: take use cases from prototype to production-grade agentic systems with the engineering rigour that implies.
In Products: configure and deploy pre-built agentic products into client environments.
Design on the Avanade Agentic Platform and the Microsoft AI stack, choosing the right combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and AAP for the business problem.
Apply AI-native engineering practices — agent-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
Work with Trust Architects on evaluation, accuracy and guardrails as part of the build, not as a later gate.
Work with Value Architects so what is built stays connected to the measurable outcome it was funded for.
Contribute reusable components, patterns and assets to the APAC IP library and the Avanade Agentic Platform on every engagement.
Operate with high autonomy in the client's environment, including in the ambiguity of early-stage discovery.

KEY MEASURES

Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
Production-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
Demonstrable productivity through AI-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.
Accuracy and evaluation thresholds met before release.

Qualifications

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

5+ years in software or AI engineering, with production systems to point to.
Strong practical command of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and agent orchestration; equivalent depth on another stack considered if the transfer is credible.
Full-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole.
Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.
Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else.
Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.
